### What to do next (recommended run order)
Run exactly the three “Next Commands” you listed, in order:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

**Why this order:**
1) `aub_autopilot ... --select-best` will propose/try module-level variations and pick the best performer (fastest way to get a better candidate than the last one).
2) `system_autopilot` then evaluates higher-level system candidates (integration-level effects, cross-module interactions).
3) `aub_next_fix` produces a concrete fix list/report based on what the registry says is currently limiting.

- **Beat champion lockbox_mean** (or come very close) *and*
- Not degrade worst_mdd beyond **-0.0815** unless there’s a clear compensating gain in lockbox_mean.

If your selection script already enforces this, great—just mentioning because the last PASS candidate would not qualify under these priorities.
